title: What Gets Hacked in a Collaborative Reward for LLM Recommenders: The Part That Does Not Depend on the User
abstract: arXiv:2611.07588v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaborative-filtering (CF) scores provide graded, personalized rewards for training large language model (LLM) recommenders through reinforcement learning. However, these rewards can cause exposure collapse: even though the CF model itself produces diverse top recommendations across users, an LLM optimized with its rewards concentrates on fewer items. We decompose each score into an item-mean component, the item's average CF score across user histories, and a residual component, the current user's score deviation from the average. Through controlled interventions, we identify the item-mean component as a contributor to exposure collapse. Accordingly, we propose two reward corrections: per-item centering removes each item's estimated mean score, while per-item standardization further rescales the residual using its estimated standard deviation. translated_title: LLM推荐器中协同奖励被“钻空子”的部分：不依赖于用户的那一部分
translated_abstract: 协同过滤（CF）分数可通过强化学习为训练大型语言模型（LLM）推荐器提供分级化的个性化奖励。然而，这些奖励可能导致曝光坍缩：尽管CF模型本身在不同用户之间能产生多样化的热门推荐，但用其奖励优化的LLM却集中于较少的物品。我们将每个分数分解为物品均值分量（该物品在所有用户历史中的平均CF分数）和残差分量（当前用户的分数相对平均值的偏差）。通过受控干预实验，我们确定物品均值分量是导致曝光坍缩的一个因素。据此，我们提出两种奖励修正方法：逐物品中心化（去除每个物品的估计平均分），以及逐物品标准化（使用估计标准差进一步对残差进行重新缩放）。在两个数据集和两种标识符方案上的实验表明，两种修正方法都能显著……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文发现LLM推荐器强化学习所用协同过滤奖励中不依赖用户的物品均值分量是导致曝光坍缩的原因，并提出逐物品中心化与标准化两种奖励修正方法来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the user-independent item-mean component of collaborative-filtering rewards as a cause of exposure collapse in RL-trained LLM recommenders, and proposes per-item centering and standardization reward corrections to mitigate it.
